title: Venezuelan Apple Bisque
description: A creamy and sweet soup made with Venezuelan spices and apples. Perfect for a cold winter day.
instructions: Heat the olive oil in a large pot over medium heat.
Add the onion and garlic and cook until softened, about 5 minutes.
Add the apples and cook until tender, about 10 minutes.
Add the bisque, cumin, paprika, and sugar. Stir well.
Bring the mixture to a boil, then reduce the heat to low and simmer for 10 minutes.
Use an immersion blender to puree the soup until smooth.
Return the pot to medium heat and cook for 5 minutes, or until heated through.
Serve hot, garnished with chopped fresh herbs if desired.
